Advances: ancora.derive

Stage: L8 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Derive.Extract (all clauses for {M,f,a} after default expansion across def/defmacro/defguard/defdelegate; sibling attributes excluded; one source-ordered list), Ancora.Canonical (metadata strip only; no alpha-renaming; charlist/sigil non-normalization documented; mix format --migrate named as an expect-acknowledgment case), Ancora.Derive.Compare (drift only where the defining file is in the change set; dedupe per definition; growth/shrink from set difference; AR6 generated-binding rules incl. companion __using__/1 bindings and the transition-is-drift rule), Ancora.Derive.Ack (substantive requirement/scenario change against parsed spec AST, whitespace collapsed in string values), Ancora.SubjectFiles (footprint = tagged test files union derived-binding defining files), and the Ancora.Derive pipeline orchestration (Task.async_stream over tagged test files, ordered: false, max_concurrency schedulers_online, workers share only the ETS memo).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.derive.clause_extraction, canonical_is_metadata_strip, drift_scope_and_dedupe, growth_and_shrink, generated_bindings, acknowledgment_is_substantive, subject_footprint, formatter_round_trip (canonical half)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.derive.scenario.canonical_table, defdelegate_retarget_fires, doc_only_edit_is_quiet, default_arity_reports_once, unchanged_file_not_parsed, macro_injected_api_drifts_via_companion, repo_insert_stays_silent, def_moved_into_use_is_drift, whitespace_never_acknowledges (stream_data; the two branches must be able to disagree), meta_edit_does_not_acknowledge, footprint_union, new_dir_new_test_is_growth (growth half), deleted_module_visible_at_base (shrink half), own_corpus_round_trip (canonical half)
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: Compare/Ack/SubjectFiles consumed by Gate (L9); proving tests here are the unit matrices
  - Fixture hygiene: all-pure modules; fixtures are source strings; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each canonical row, each AR6 rule, each Ack branch)
- Call-site Integration: Ancora.Gate (L9) calls Derive.run/2 then Compare and Ack per subject; proving tests here are the unit matrices, and L9 adds diff-scoping integration cases.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
- lib/ancora/derive/{change_set,module_locator,membership,def_index,resolver}.ex (read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/derive/extract.ex, lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex, lib/ancora/derive/ack.ex, lib/ancora/canonical.ex, lib/ancora/subject_files.ex, lib/ancora/derive.ex (pipeline)
- test/ancora/derive/{extract,compare,ack,pipeline}_test.exs, test/ancora/{canonical,subject_files}_test.exs, test/fixtures/**, test/support/**
- NOTICE (Canonical origin)
- .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no alpha-renaming; no sigil/charlist folding; no hashing anywhere in the detector path
- no finding for dep-generated bindings
- no parsing of files outside the change set for drift

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

TEST_CRITIC: FAIL
Session: 68fab1f9-dfb5-49e0-be76-afa9d2d00f6d
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-ancora/68fab1f9-dfb5-49e0-be76-afa9d2d00f6d.jsonl

Blocking findings:

1. test/ancora/derive/ack_test.exs:9-18 — the whitespace_never_acknowledges property is examples in a costume, the exact L7b bounce pattern. The generator draws only a separator from member_of of four fixed strings; the sentence, the spec template, and the word-level edit are all hardcoded. It is worse than four examples: I verified by running the variants through Ack.parse that the " " gap produces a head byte-identical to base (asserting nothing beyond x != x being false), and YAML plain-scalar folding collapses the "\n      " gap before Ack.normalize/1 runs. Only the "  " and "\t" cases touch the normalization under test. The spec scenario demands stream_data whitespace-only mutations of the requirement block plus a generated word edit. Missed failures: normalize bugs visible only on other shapes — leading/trailing whitespace, whitespace in non-statement fields, multiple requirements, whitespace inside scenario entries (the list/map recursion at lib/ancora/derive/ack.ex:67-71 is never reached by the property), entry reordering. No property input can make those branches disagree.

2. test/ancora/derive/ack_test.exs — no test anywhere exercises substantive?'s error fallback (lib/ancora/derive/ack.ex:19) or parse(nil) (ack.ex:30). Mutations that survive the green suite: flip the else branch to true (a YAML-broken head spec then counts as acknowledgment); make parse(nil) error (a newly added spec file with requirements then never acknowledges). The invalid_ack_block branches (ack.ex:46-49) are equally dead in tests. Each Ack branch needs a row.

3. test/ancora/derive/pipeline_test.exs — both tests run exactly one file for one subject, so the ordered: false fan-in (lib/ancora/derive.ex:63-73) and build_subject_sets (derive.ex:148-168) are exercised only trivially. Surviving mutations: associate task results to files positionally instead of via the path-keyed resolutions map; drop either Enum.uniq (derive.ex:62, 150); flip the collect_resolution error halt (derive.ex:145) to cont, silently swallowing resolver failures — no test feeds an unparseable tagged test through run/2. Needs a multi-subject, multi-file run with a file shared between subjects, and one error-path run asserting {:error, _}.

4. lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex:62 — stacked-gate gap in transition_findings. The only transition test (compare_test.exs:149, def_moved_into_use) puts the defining file in the change set, so deleting the changed_definition? filter on the transition path leaves the suite green (unchanged_file_not_parsed has the binding textual on both sides and never reaches transitions). Missed failure: a binding textual-at-base/generated-at-head whose file is outside the diff fires derived/drift on every unrelated run, violating drift_scope_and_dedupe. The uniq_by dedupe at compare.ex:63 is also untested — default_arity_reports_once only covers the textual-drift dedupe.

5. lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex:126-134 — the unparseable-source and locator-miss branches of compare_binding have zero coverage in this diff. Replacing the {:finding, unparseable_finding(...)} branch with {:equal, ...} keeps the suite green; a syntax-broken watched file would then suppress drift silently instead of emitting derived/unparseable_source. If the unparseable_base_file scenario belongs to a later ticket, say so on the ticket; the branch still landed here untested.

Notes (advisory):
- Extract's quote-skip clauses (lib/ancora/derive/extract.ex:46-47, 66-68) are untested; deleting them stays green. A def inside a quote block would be extracted as a textual clause of the enclosing module.
- canonical_test own_corpus_round_trip covers only the normalize half of ancora.derive.formatter_round_trip; the "identical call sets" half is absent — fine if a resolver-side test owns it, worth confirming.
- The 1_000 vs 1000 equal row cannot fail even if normalize becomes identity (both parse to identical single-line ASTs); harmless, but it is a parser fact, not a normalize fact.
- subject_files_test covers only side: :head and no locator-miss binding; one more row would pin the :error skip.

Done well: the raising source_reader sentinel in unchanged_file_not_parsed and the defimpl test genuinely proves no parse happens and kills the "any diff change admits" mutation of changed_definition?; default_arity_reports_once kills the dedupe-key-includes-arity mutation; the canonical unequal rows pin no-alpha-renaming and charlist/sigil distinctness; growth cap "+2 more" is checked with 12 bindings; all files async, no sleeps, no VM-global state, fixtures are source strings.
